people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: As they traveled from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
translations.bsb: And as people journeyed eastward, they found a plain in the land of Shinar and settled there.
